description: Use this when the user compares the long-run cost of several names or extensions, at one registrar or the cheapest. Applies minimum terms and regular renewals; with transfer_after_year it also finds the cheapest registrar to move to later. Up to 20 domains or extensions in one call.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices (default USD); converted at the ECB's daily rate, disclosed in `fx`

include_limited_promos.description: count limited promotions (one per customer, first-time customers only) in totals and rankings; default false: they are listed and flagged promo_limited, but year 1 is priced at the regular price

include_resellers.description: include registrars whose prices are a reseller account's tier (pricing_tier reseller, e.g. eNom); default false

registrar.description: price at this registrar; default: the cheapest to own

items.description: an extension: com, .io, co.uk or рф

transfer_after_year.description: also price moving to the cheapest renewing registrar after this many years

name: total_cost_of_ownership

as_of.description: when the newest price in this response was collected

date.description: the date of the primary rates (ECB reference rates)

rate.description: units of the response currency per unit of this currency

rates.description: every rate used in this response, by native currency

examples: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates

fx.description: How converted prices were converted; null when nothing needed converting.

input.description: the domain or extension as asked

anyOf.description: A short, sourced note about the registrar's prices (not a price we rank by).

examples: NameSilo's free discount program prices .com at $12.00 (retail $19.99).

url.description: where the note's facts come from

pricing_tier.description: retail: anyone can buy at these prices; reseller: the prices are a reseller account's tier (eNom's Silver), left out of consumer rankings unless include_resellers=true

url.description: the registrar's website (a plain link, no affiliate code)

registrar.description: the registrar asked for, else the cheapest to own

kind.description: api: the registrar's own price API; price_list: a file or JSON the registrar publishes; page: its price page; mirror: a third party's copy of the registrar's prices

saving.description: total without the switch minus total with it

anyOf.description: A short, sourced note about the registrar's prices (not a price we rank by).

examples: NameSilo's free discount program prices .com at $12.00 (retail $19.99).

url.description: where the note's facts come from

pricing_tier.description: retail: anyone can buy at these prices; reseller: the prices are a reseller account's tier (eNom's Silver), left out of consumer rankings unless include_resellers=true

url.description: the registrar's website (a plain link, no affiliate code)

total.description: register at `registrar`, transfer to `to` after `after_year` years, renew there

transfer.description: An amount in major units (12.99), in `currency`.

switch.description: transfer_after_year: the cheapest registrar to transfer to, when that saves money

anyOf.description: The cost of owning the domain for `years` years (packages/core computeTco).

amount.description: An amount in major units (12.99), in `currency`.

estimated.description: a year whose regular price is unknown was priced at the regular renewal: the total is an estimate

first_payment.description: charged at checkout: year 1 (promotional price if one runs) plus the rest of the minimum term at the regular price; for a transfer, the transfer price x its term

limited_promo_skipped.description: a limited promotion runs (per customer, first-time customers) and was not counted: year 1 is the regular price

total.description: first payment plus every later year at the regular renew price (never a renewal promotion)

years_paid.description: years paid for: at least min_years when starting with a registration

totals.description: with the year-by-year breakdown; null when no registrar has both prices

title: Total cost of ownership
